rows.name: Charge quantization
rows.test: integer topological charge; a split e → e/2 + e/2 impossible
rows.result: Independent observers recovered the signs of seeded vortices in the formed matter, while resolved unseeded contours had zero winding. The native observer could identify split constituents but had no charge-sensitive response to distinguish full-charge and half-charge assignments.

rows.name: Electron rest energy (mass)
rows.test: localized state anchored to 511 keV

rows.name: de Broglie clock (Zitterbewegung)
rows.test: self-starting frequency-rigid internal oscillation at ω = mc²/ℏ
rows.result: The uniform relative clock reads the internal level splitting, roughly 1/128 of the lower rest phase. Six privately excited single-rail cases give an autonomous routing-occupation line at twice the independently measured branch frequency. The required electron clock at one rest frequency and its rigidity under a drive remain open.

rows.name: Particle stability (Derrick escape)
rows.test: the particle state persists in free evolution
rows.result: A prepared localized two-constituent circulation passed the finite free-persistence test on every finalist, with zero losses through three closed-wire memory wraps and about 75% breakup under independent routing. Ordinary collisions cannot form that protected mode. The ordinary moving product survives on a long lead and can split on the original closed lead.

rows.name: Angular momentum J (spin ℏ/2)

rows.name: Electric force (Coulomb 1/r, electrostatics)
rows.test: far-field 1/r potential at charge e; the strength (α) credited only when it follows from the model's own mechanism, never fitted
rows.result: All 24 separated-source comparisons at calibrated ranges three and five met the registered 0.01-radian equivalence test. Contact still produced a marker in about half the trials. Physical electric charge and a responding far-field 1/r potential on these laws remain open.

rows.name: Lorentz covariance (+ Coulomb = EM)
rows.test: Lorentz-invariant action, no preferred frame; boosted states contract, c-limited
rows.result: The selected formed pairs pass the long-wave shell at the two smallest momenta. Ordinary constituent signals vanish at fixed margins ahead of the scalar cone with polynomial resources under refinement. Exponential resources recover an earlier finite signal. Boosts, rod contraction and a universal invariant action remain open.

rows.name: Gravity: Newton limit (GEM)

rows.name: Gravity: local metric phenomena

rows.name: Cosmology: Λ / cosmic acceleration

rows.name: EM waves (Maxwell)
rows.test: Maxwell recovered; transverse waves at c
rows.result: Scalar flight agreed with the independent optical standard in six signed directions. Both readable transverse polarizations and the emitted neutral marker remained at the source. The finite free spectrum separates the moving scalar sector from the stationary transverse doublet.

rows.name: Quantum wave equation (Klein-Gordon)
rows.test: emergent ω² = k² + m² for matter waves
rows.result: All 14 held-out directions per law at periods 64, 128 and 256 passed the effective long-wave dispersion test, using the registered precision repeat at 256. The altered rule failed at every period. A supplied gap and a finite slope difference from the scalar limit qualify this result.
